name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JUNE 13, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Smith and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar
7A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of May 16, 2019.
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 15-036 Major Modification No. 2 / Site Plan Review 19-009
Bouma USA, Applicant
A request to construct a sports complex as an expansion of the Palmdale Aerospace Academy.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-026 approving Conditional Use Permit 15-036 MM No. 2 and Site Plan Review 19-009 and find that the project includes minor alterations to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for the previously approved project, CUP 15-036, as outlined within the Subsequent Initial Study. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 08-16 Time Extension No. 1
SBA Towers III, LLC, Applicant
A request for a 10-year time extension for the previously approved major communication facility at 37822 6th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-022 approving CUP 08-16 Time Extension No. 1, and find that the previously adopted MND adequately addresses the project. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Tentative Tract Map 54058 Time Extension No. 2
Pacific Communities, Applicant
A request for a second three-year discretionary time extension for Tentative Tract Map 54058; a subdivision of approximately 131 acres into 492 single family residential located south of West Avenue P-8, between 20th Street West and 25th Street West.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. 2019-021 approving TTM 54058 TE No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8C
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Mark Oyler, Director of Economic & Community Development
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, July 11, 2019, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
www.ci tyofpalmdale.org
Auxiliary Aids provided for Communication Accessibility upon 72 hour notice and request.
